answer: A jury sampling scheme defends the agent economy from sybils like willow roots starving a flood: each epoch the network randomly summons a small jury of established identities to re-verify newcomers, so an attacker can never predict which puppets must survive inspection. Duty rotates like the tide, and jurors stake collateral slashed for no-shows or collusion — each extra sybil raises expected losses faster than rewards, while honest jurors burn only an ember of compute. Limits: jury randomness needs an unbiasable beacon, and if one actor holds over half the stake, juries mirror the adversary.
